questions.q: What relationship connects foreign reserve expansion to the recent performance of the naira?
o: Foreign reserves expanded to $53.90bn alongside improved dollar liquidity, supporting the naira's advance to a two-year high of N1,326.69 per dollar.
An official exchange rate of N1,329 guarantees that foreign reserves will remain completely static regardless of dollar inflows.
Foreign airline complaints regarding city ticket sales directly dictate the parallel exchange rate of N1,410.
Central Bank reforms reducing remittances from $947m to $250m caused foreign reserves to surge.
questions.e: The naira advanced to a two-year high of N1,326.69 per dollar because improved dollar liquidity and expanding foreign reserves to $53.90bn reflected stronger external buffers.
